note: [EVIDENCE-BASED v2.0] Hybrid routing schema for SPACE CDS L2/L3 assignment. Signals combined by recommend_assignment_v2: (1) `hard_rules` regex shortcuts run FIRST and short-circuit on match (confidence 0.95); (2) keyword scorer per group (substring + boundary_keywords); (3) sentence-transformers kNN retrieval over historical tickets; (4) `l3_escalation` triggers escalation from L2 winner to its L3 counterpart when escalation_signals are found in text. The downstream LLM agent (Claude Code / Copilot) sees ALL three signals and is instructed to reason about them — the deterministic combined recommendation is its baseline, not a hard answer.

hard_rules.target: APAC - ZN - O+O OMNISALES.RETAIL - CAPGEMINI-GDC-MARS - RUN - L2
hard_rules.reason: MARS-{COUNTRY} uppercase prefix tag (e.g. [MARS-ANZ]) indicates explicit MARS/OMNISALES ownership. Case-sensitive to avoid colliding with 'mars-id' (customer identifier).

hard_rules.target: TECH FNDN - WW - HIP INCIDENT L2
hard_rules.reason: Infrastructure-alert signature (Capgemini Linux line error, FS usage, disk threshold)

hard_rules.target: TECH FNDN - WW - HIP INCIDENT L2

hard_rules.reason: Brand-specific hypercare mention — routes to general B2C Hypercare until Aesop has its own canonical group

l3_escalation.comment: When an L2 group wins the keyword/retrieval scoring AND any escalation_signals appear in the ticket text, route to the L2's l3_counterpart instead. Only L2 groups with an entry in l2_to_l3 are escalatable.

l2_to_l3.APAC - ZN - O+O.NGLORA - L2: APAC - CHN - SPACE Loyalty L3 Support

APAC - SGP - SPACE CDS SAPMENA L2 Suppor.description: SAP/ERP integration; Singapore-hosted SPACE CDS; SAPMENA pipeline; SFCC -> CDS exchanges; API failures (FindConsumerProfile, GetCustomerById, GetPurchaseV2); E2E Monitoring alerts; Outbound Gap Data tickets; staging-table SQL errors.

APAC - THN - Retail IT.description: [USER-CONFIRM] Thailand retail IT — in-store POS systems and store network. NO incidents in the quick-018 sample; keywords are inferred from the group name. Validate against a wider SNOW fetch before relying on this rule.

APAC - ZN - iBeauty 2.0 - Retail - L2.description: [USER-CONFIRM] iBeauty 2.0 retail app. iBeauty issues in the quick-018 sample landed in SAPMENA L2/L3 or B2C Hypercare, NOT in this group — so the keywords are validated as unique to *this* L2 only if/when an iBeauty 2.0 ticket actually sits here. `BA` is matched on word boundary to avoid substring traps (e.g. matching `based`, `above`).

APAC - ZN - O+O OMNISALES.RETAIL - CAPGE.description: [USER-CONFIRM] Omnichannel retail (Capgemini MARS team). Removed `MARS`, `Capgemini`, `omni`, `GDC` from quick-018 v1.0 — those terms had 100 % drift (47 / 30 / 2 / 1 hits, all in other groups). Kept only the most group-specific phrases. Real reassignment notes use `retail Ops team` and `MARS Ops` — added.

APAC - ZN - O+O ONLINE.CED - CAPGEMINI-G.description: [USER-CONFIRM] Online e-commerce (Capgemini SPACE GDS team). Added SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud — explicit reassignment target in INC10442394), EBTQ (E-Boutique registration channel), Arvato (3PL endpoint — appeared in INC10466356). Removed `e-commerce`, `web order`, `cart`, `checkout`, `online store`, `SPACE-GDS` (all 0 hits in 64-ticket sample).

APAC - ZN - O+O.CRM - L2.description: [USER-CONFIRM] CRM / consumer identity / Salesforce platform. The quick-018 sample exposed that the v1.0 CRM rule was the WORST false-positive driver: 4 of its 6 keywords (`lucid`, `CRM`, `loyalty`, `account`) hit universal nouns and matched 28-37 incidents each — 100 % in OTHER groups. Removed those four. Added evidence-backed signals from the sample: SFMC Prospect (INC10475182, INC10483228), SFDC (INC10466783), CRM001 file outbound (INC10142664). Kept only consent / GDPR (specific legal-data signals).

APAC - ZN - O+O.NGLORA - L2.description: [USER-CONFIRM] NGLORA loyalty platform. v1.0 had `NGLORA`, `LORA`, `ORA` — `NGLORA` and `LORA` had 0 hits, and `ORA` had 8 substring matches all in wrong groups (matches `respective`, `operations`, etc). Real text uses `NGL` (which needs word-boundary or it matches `nigella`, etc.). Real handoff: 'Assigning to NGL L2' (INC10442394). Added `Rule-500` (NGLORA rule engine alert, INC10403825), `loyalty rewards programme`.

APAC - ZN - O+O.OPERATIONS - L2.description: [USER-CONFIRM] Operational issues — ETL, API, data pipelines. The quick-018 sample showed every v1.0 keyword (API, batch, ETL, pipeline, integration, ops, operations) had 100 % drift — they're universal in this domain. Kept ONLY the most operations-specific multi-word phrases. This group is intended as the silent fallback when no other group scores hits; relying on single-word matches was the bug.

APAC - ZN - SPACE B2C Hypercare.description: Post-go-live hypercare for new market launches. Validated against the 64-incident sample (19 incidents). `hypercare` alone hit 12 times with 8 in own group (drift 0.33 — the best-performing keyword in the dataset). `B2C` hit 13/5 (drift 0.62). Removed `P1`, `escalation`, `new market`, `regression`, `cutover` (all 0 hits). Added `LS team` and `LS Hypercare` — these are recurring reassignment destinations in real work-notes.

TECH FNDN - WW - HIP INCIDENT L2.description: [USER-CONFIRM] Technical foundation — infrastructure, cloud, certificates. HIP group had 0 tickets in the quick-018 sample, so drift cannot be measured. Kept domain-specific tokens, removed `network`, `DNS`, `certificate` (0 hits). Added concrete signals from the sample: `CloudSQL` (INC10450026), `Replica` (INC10450026), `Linux Host`, `FS /mnt`, `disk usage`, `Cloudflare`/`Cloudfare` (INC10466356 — note 3rd-party 3PL spelling variant), `Azure`.
